name: jarvis-avatar-web
description: The 3D head shown on the Android home screen. Bundled into app/src/main/assets/jarvis.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../app/src/main/assets/jarvis/jarvis.js && cp src/index.html models/jarvis.glb models/anim.glb ../app/src/main/assets/jarvis/
